mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines do not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it indicates a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of UNRATE > 5% and FEDFUNDS > 3% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in 1 month do not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 12-month moving average does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns with a significance level of p < 0.05.
